To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(1) the conjectured SL (2, Z) duality of the type II superstring in ten dimensions persists in lower dimensions; (2) the conjectured duality implies the existence of an infinite set of black hole solutions in four dimensions; (3) these black holes are characterized by two integers, the magnetic charges associated to the two gauge fields; (4) the solutions are extremal and stable in the sense that they do not decay into lower mass black holes.
We find an infinite family of black holes in type IIB superstring theory in D=4.

1) The conjectured SL( 2, Z) duality invariance of string theory in four dimensions persists when the theory is further compactified on torus; 2) The SL(2, 2) multiplets of magnetically charged extremal black holes in four space-time dimension have the same structure as in ten dimensions; 3) The SL( 2,Z) multiplet of magnetically charged extreme black holes in four dimensions has a `mass gap'.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the construction of a class of exact solutions to the equations of motion for type IIA and IIB string theories in four space-time dimenions.
the construction of black hole solutions in four space-time dimension of type II superstrings compactified on toroidal backgrounds.
the study of black holes in string theory and their thermodynamic properties.

we have constructed an infinite family of stable, magnetically charged extremal black holes in D = 4 type II superstrings.
the SL(2, R) duality in D=4, N=2 type II string theory has been realized at the level of the classical solutions of the theory.

The main takeaway from our work is that
, in four dimensions, the SL(2, R) duality of type IIB superstring theory is realized in terms of an infinite family of black holes.
the SL(2, R) symmetry of the low energy theory in four space time dimensions is enhanced to SL(2, C) when the theory is quantized.
the SL(2, R) symmetry, which has long been suspected to be a hidden symmetry of string theory, can be realized in terms of the physical charges and masses of the black holes in four dimensions.
